title: Splinting loose teeth
what: The dentist joins loose teeth to their neighbors with a thin strip or wire. This helps the teeth hold more firmly.
why: When teeth are loose because of gum disease or after an injury.
tell_doctor: Gum disease and how long the teeth have been loose

prepare.title: Teeth
prepare.text: Brush your teeth before the visit.

prepare.title: Cleaning
prepare.text: A professional teeth cleaning is often done first. Ask the clinic.

bring: Dental X-rays, if you have them
steps: The teeth are cleaned of plaque
A small groove is made on the inside of the teeth, or the surface is simply prepared
The strip or wire is laid in place
It is fixed with filling material and light
feel: For the first days you can feel the splint with your tongue
after: Clean around the splint with a small brush and floss
Do not bite hard food with these teeth
Continue gum treatment if it was prescribed
Come to check-ups at the set time
red_flags: The splint has chipped off or broken

faq.a: It varies. After an injury it is temporary, and with gum disease it can stay for a long time. The doctor decides.

faq.q: Can I eat normally with a splint?
faq.a: Almost, but it is best not to bite hard food with the splinted teeth.

reminders.text: Tooth splinting tomorrow. Brush your teeth and bring X-rays if you have them.
